nodes.title: Approval lane, regeneration round 1 (one game per staged scripted topic, each aimed at its script's first remediation), run by main on Studio 9e108c2bc: 30 topics, 43 model calls, $0.0560 (lane total $0.0835). 19 topics produced a candidate; 11 were refused on both attempts. 24 refused attempts by reason: contentSafe 12 (9 brain_violence on a turret game's coach string containing 'fire', all on the four class 6 angle topics; 3 content_safety_2 on romanised Hindi geometry terms 'SEEDHA KON', 'Bindu se samkon par', 'Bindu se rekha par'), unverified_key 7, fell_back 3, onTopic 2. No judge has seen the candidates. Outputs on claude/r4-content-candidates 300b166d8, data/studio-approved/candidates-regen-r1/.

The Azure content check scores some short romanised Hindi strings at severity 2 with nothing unsafe in them: 'Teen hisse' (three parts), 'SEEDHA KON' (straight angle), 'Bindu se samkon par' (at a right angle from the point). 6 such refusals in 2 runs (n = 48 attempts). The words involved differ, so it is not one word; it is short romanised Hindi read without context. Not measured on teacher lines or kits. The check stays as it is (frozen); specs avoid the scoring term by using digits or the Hinglish term the teacher's lines use.
